create_BaspachoSparseSolver: create a BaspachoSparseSolver instance with an Objective and optional SparseLinearization class
reset_BaspachoSparseSolver_device: reset the BaspachoSparseSolver to a new device like cuda or cpu

review_BaspachoSparseSolver_symbolic_dec: review the BaspachoSparseSolver reset method that builds the SymbolicDecomposition from sparse structure
